headline: Opposition Leaders Begin Training For Marathon Election Commission Visit By Practicing Synchronized Walking
body:
Ahead of the high-stakes INDIA bloc meeting regarding Election Commission protocols, veteran political strategists were spotted yesterday practicing synchronized walking in a vacant stadium to prepare for the long, solemn stroll to the Commission's headquarters. The training, which involves maintaining a strict four-abreast formation at exactly 0.5 kilometers per hour, is intended to ensure that no leader reaches the entrance ahead of the others, thereby preserving the visual unity of their delegation.

"The walk is the most crucial part of the memorandum submission process," said a senior aide to the coalition who requested anonymity while polishing his comfortable, protest-ready walking shoes. "If someone trips or accidentally breaks into a light jog, it could be interpreted by the media as a rift in the alliance. We are training to achieve a collective gait that says 'deeply concerned' but 'strictly democratic' without losing momentum."

Participants are also reportedly undergoing endurance drills to keep a stoic, unified expression for the duration of the 200-meter walk from their parked SUVs to the front gate. Sources within the camp confirm that they have hired a specialized choreographer from the film industry to refine their posture, ensuring that when they finally face the cameras, their collective silence communicates exactly the right amount of intense, parliamentary disapproval.
caption: Forget policy shifts, the real battle is won in the synchronized stride to the front gate. Coordination is everything in this political marathon. #INDIAbloc #ElectionCommission #Politics #Satire (satire)
igHook: Would you survive this intense tactical walking drill, or would you be the one to break stride?
